title: DeeToo Admin Next Phase 1 Backend Integration Capability Matrix
auditType: Static source code; runtime not verified

baseline.previousPhases: Visual/screens completed and approved; no API connected in admin-web-next

legend.R: REUSE: existing suitable server route/service at code level
legend.E: EXTEND: backend exists but DTO, policy, read model or UX contract is incomplete
legend.N: NEW: necessary backend contract or store not identified
legend.UI: UI-ONLY: preserve UX; no production API write should be introduced

Replace fake role selector with real cookie/token session; recover 401 and MFA step-up.

Use 3-digit code, URL-level filter propagation and supported county fields.
Build scoped aggregate/read model; outbound notification log != admin inbox.
Stream only invalidations; refetch authorized resources and retry on disconnect.
